text:
Priya Shah: Heads-up: Monday KPI deck draft shows launch post drove sessions but conversions per session are way down. Need to decide if this is a UX drop or attribution noise.
Cole Matthews: can you paste the slide number? also which conversion metric are we using (signup vs demo request)?
Priya Shah: slide 4 (Performance overview). using "webinar_reg" as conversion for this deck. weekly snapshot: sessions +48%, webinar_reg -36% week-over-week.
Ravi Singh: I pulled the raw table from the dashboard. quick SQL: 
```
SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as day, sum(sessions) as sessions, sum(webinar_reg) as regs
FROM marketing.kpi_daily
WHERE campaign = 'launch-apr-2026'
AND created_at >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
```
Shows spike on 2026-04-09 in sessions with no matching regs bump.
Olivia Chen: frontend note: we pushed a copy tweak + a new third-party pixel the morning of 4/9. possible that the pixel interferes with form load on some browsers.
marketing-bot: ALERT: pixel-load-errors increased 300% for landing page /launch on 2026-04-09 08:14 UTC. See: https://redwood.app/monitoring/pixels/launch
Cole Matthews: could also be UTMs on the syndicated newsletter strips — some variants used `utm_medium=organic` accidentally. that shifts channel attribution in the deck.
Priya Shah: action items I propose: 1) Ravi to backfill ingest for 4/7-4/10 to catch any lost events; 2) Olivia to validate pixel and form load across browsers; 3) Cole to re-run deck with both last-touch and data-driven attribution and attach both slides.
Ravi Singh: starting backfill now. job id 1102. ETA ~90m. I'll post numbers when done.
Olivia Chen: checking pixel. found one failing script on IE11 and Safari older versions; percentage small but could explain drop in registrants from corporate networks. filing PR with fix: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/502
Cole Matthews: will generate alternate slides and leave a note: "Attribution model materially changes share of conversions for launch campaign; see appendix."
Priya Shah: thanks. hold any messaging changes until we confirm backfill. I'll update the deck and flag the Monday review with a short appendix slide.
marketing-bot: BACKFILL job 1102 started by Ravi Singh (status: running).
Ravi Singh: backfill complete. Adjusted webinar_reg +34 for 4/09-4/10. final weekly delta now -20% (vs initial -36%). Posting updated CSV: https://redwood.app/files/launch-backfill-1102.csv
Priya Shah: great, that moves the needle but still below target. we'll present both attribution views and note pixel/UTM fixes. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
